Services

Residential Pressure Washing

Driveways, walks, patios, pool decks and other hard surfaces around a Houston home, matched with a company that sizes the pressure to the surface.

Read more

House Washing and Soft Washing

Low-pressure soft washing for brick, fiber cement, vinyl and stucco, so green mildew and black streaks come off without forcing water behind the siding.

Read more

Roof Cleaning

Soft wash roof cleaning for the black streaks, moss and lichen that build up on Houston shingles, tile and metal roofs.

Read more

Driveway and Sidewalk Cleaning

Concrete driveways, front walks and curb strips cleaned with surface cleaners, plus treatment for tire marks, mildew and the dark band along the lawn edge.

Read more

Commercial Pressure Washing

Storefronts, sidewalks, dumpster pads, drive-thrus and building exteriors for Houston businesses, with work that can be planned around opening hours.

Read more

Fence Cleaning

Gray, mildewed wood fences brought back without furring the boards, plus vinyl and wrought iron fences.

Read more

Deck and Patio Cleaning

Wood and composite decks, pavers and stamped concrete patios cleaned for the surface they are, with time to dry before any stain.

Read more

Gutter Cleaning and Brightening

The black tiger stripes on the outside of gutters and fascia, often handled together with a house wash.

Read more

Oil and Rust Stain Removal

Oil drips, fertilizer rust and orange irrigation stains on concrete, treated with the right product before any rinse.

Read more

Houston Power Washing Pro is a free phone line, not a pressure washing company. It connects you with an independent local pressure washing company, which inspects, quotes, does the work and is paid by you directly. Houston Power Washing Pro never charges callers. It may be paid a referral fee by the companies it connects callers with.
